newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Mortgage gets revised offer.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Mortgage gets revised offer.

text.p: Banyan Mortgage Investment Fund said Monday it has received a new acquisition proposal from Apollo Real Estate Advisors LP.

Under the proposal, Apollo would purchase up to $5 million of newly created class 'B' common shares which the company would need shareholder approval to issue and make available up to $50 million to the company for certain acquisitions.
The new shares would give Apollo up to 25 percent economic interest in the company, as well as 10 votes per share and the right to elect a majority of the fund's board, Banyan said.
The proposal also contemplates the conveyance of substantially all the fund's assets to RGI Holdings, which had agreed to merge its subisidiary, RGI U.S. Holdings, with Banyan Mortgage in April.
Apollo would also pay RGI $500,000 for an option to buy one million shares of the company's stock currently owned by RGI for $1 a share, Banyan said. Banyan has received other takeover proposals.
The company said it has set a board meeting Thursday to consider the proposal.
